Pray Farmstead(s)
The loafing/ machine shed is a post and beam structure with an asphalt shingle roof and corrugated metal panel siding on the north, west, and east sides.

files.title: File:Pray Farmstead Dickinson Co KS Loafing Machine Shed southeast elevation.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Pray Farmstead(s)
The south side is open and and the roof is supported by six hedge posts. Its dimensions are approximately 16’-0” N-S by 39’-0” E-W.
